The Challenges of FBR Compliance in Pakistan

Pakistani businesses face numerous challenges when it comes to FBR compliance. The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has implemented various regulations, including SRO 1006 and SRO 673, to ensure that businesses comply with tax laws. However, many businesses struggle to comply with these regulations due to the complexity of the tax laws and the lack of a reliable POS system.

Non-compliance with FBR regulations can result in significant penalties and fines, which can be detrimental to a business. Therefore, it is essential for businesses to ensure FBR compliance to avoid these penalties and focus on growing their business.
